contexts.text: The Lord never turns away His face from anyone; but it is man, who w-hen in evil, turns away his own face.
The Lord turns it into good.
Because they had turned away from the Lord.
That man would not any more so turn himself away. Signified, Explained.
To be cursed = to turn one's self away. AC 5071.
Turns the light into ugly colours... as a wicked man turns benefits into vituperations and malice.
All the good which inflows... into the World of Spirits is turned in a moment into evil... and all the truth into falsity...
That truth turned itself away from good. Signified, Explained.
To turn one's self away from good to truth. Signified.
Heavenly delight is turned in them into what is loathsome.
(The influent life from the Lord) is turned in the evil into what is evil and false. Explained. AC 3957:7. AC 5118:2. AC 6467. AC 6991.
However one may turn himself, the Societies there always maintain the same relative situation to him. Explained. AC 3639.
The light of Heaven with such is at once turned into fatuous lumen. Explained.
The Knowledges of good are said to turn themselves back () when the good of love obtains the dominion. Explained.
All the evil which the evil intend for the good, the Lord turns into good. Example(s).
When the light of Heaven talis upon their insanities... their lumen is turned into a dusky lumen like that from a charcoal fire.
Contempt and turning away from Divine truth. Signified, Explained.
Every Spirit and Angel sees the good at the right, and the evil at the left, to whatever quarter he turns himself. Explained.
A turning away from spiritual truth. Signified, Explained.
The reason anger = a turning away, is that while a man is in anger against anyone, he turns away his lower mind from him. AC 5798.
Good (then) flows through... to the Sensuous, and is there... turned into what is filthy...
For when the things which take place in Heaven flow down towards Hell, they are turned into the opposites.
They turned clean things into unclean ones.
Human thought and speech are turned into spiritual thought and speech when they ascend.
Man is placed in this state... in order that he may be in freedom to turn whither he will...
Whatever good inflows from the Lord is turned in the Natural into evil.
Why is there a turning away? Signified, Explained.
For evil is nothing else than a turning away from good. Explained.
Lest he turn himself away. Signified, Explained.
To turn truths into goods by willing and doing them. Signified.
The state is then inverted. Explained.
That they had completely turned themselves away, and in their turning away had extinguished faith. Signified, Explained.
A grievous turning away from good, and the consequent condemnation. Signified, Explained.
A turning away from the derivative truth, that it was confirmed. Signified, Explained.
Wrath = a turning away from truth.
After death (this delight) is turned into what is sad and shocking.
When the truth of the Spiritual Church becomes good, a turning takes place. Explained.
That they had been turned away from the wood and truth which inflow. Signified, Explained.
Evil = a turning away.
That the Divine turns evil into good. Signified. AC 6574:3. Explained.
In such combats... the Lord turns into good all the evils which the Hells intend. Explained.
When the fire of love from the Lord as a Sun enters those who are in contrary things, it is turned into the fire of cupidities... which is what torments the internals. Explained.
At the first threshold of Heaven, what is worldly of the sense of the letter is turned into the spiritual sense.
Sensuous lumen is turned into mere thick darkness when light from Heaven falls upon it.
The serpent is turned into a rod, that is, evil into good.
The glorying and gladness of the wicked is... there turned into infernal unhappiness.
When the Angels perceive the ideas of such (natural things) with man, they turn them into the corresponding spiritual ones.
Evil men also, can, if they will, turn themselves to Heaven...
The second degree, is described by the waters of Egypt turned into blood. ( = truths falsified. AC 7317.)

Hence the infernals turn the influent Divine truth into falsities; and the Divine good into evil; heavenly loves into diabolical ones; mercy into hatred and cruelty; and conjugial love into adulteries; thus into the contraries. Explained.

If the Sensuous is full of phantasies and fallacies... the truths which inflow are turned into like things; for they are received according to the induced form; and in proportion as truths are turned into falsities, in the same proportion the interiors... are closed.
Thus man turns into evil the good itself which inflows from the Lord.
For wherever the love turns itself, there the interiors of the man turn themselves. AC 7818.
Turns into evil the Divine good which continually inflows.
Man looks below himself, when he turns to himself the influx of truth and good from the Lord. Explained.
This fermentation arises when the state is turned with man. Explained.
This delight is (there) turned into undelight.
That they turned away truth Divine from themselves. Signified, Explained.
The (imperfect) quality of the truth which is turned into good with many.
Devils are allowed to act so far as... their evil can be turned into good.
To take the name of God in vain = to turn truth into evil. Explained.
For when man does evils, and thereby turns himself away from the Lord, it appears as if the Lord turns Himself away. Explained.
When the internal man is closed, truths are turned into falsities.
Not to consociate with those who turn goods and truths into evils and falsities; and the converse. Signified, Explained.
A turning away from Him through falsities from evil. Sig and Explained.
That the Lord will turn away all falsities from evil. Signified, Explained.
That He will turn away all the evils from which are falsities. Signified, Explained.
Lest evils turn away the goods which are frons the Lord. Signified, Explained.
To sin = to turn away.
With these, the Divine love... is turned into the fire or love of self and of the world...
The infernal loves... in which they are, turn the influx of good into evil, and that of truth into falsity.
No one in Heaven can look backwards from the Lord however he may turn himself. AC 9828:2.

For when a man turns himself away from the Lord, which is when he does evil, it appears as if the Lord did not see him... and the contrary when a man turns himself to the Lord, which is when he does what is good. Explained.
All in Heaven turn the face to the Lord, ta whatever quarter they may turn themselves. AC 10130:4.

All (there) turn their eyes to those whom, they love; they who love the Lord, turn their eyes to Him as a Sun; they who love the neighbour... turn their eyes to the Lord as a Moon; (and this) in whatever direction they turn themselves... But in Hell, the more they are in the love of self and the world, the more they turn themselves from the Lord... in whatever direction they turn themselves. AC 10189:2. AC 10189:3. AC 10189:4. HH 17:2. HH 123, Explained. DLW 105.
All are known there from their turning.
For the man then turns himself from Heaven and the Lord to the world and self; and his heart is where he turns himself.
That they have quite turned themselves away from the Divine. Signified, Explained.
Spirits turn themselves according to their loves.
That thus they turn themselves away from internal things, thus from Divine ones, so that they must needs perish. Signified, Explained.
The turning away of that nation from the internal of the Word, etc. Signified, Explained.
Total alienation and turning away. Signified, Explained.
That they will perish who turn themselves away from the Divine. Signified, Explained.

The Lord never turns away His face from man; but the man who is in evil turns away his own face from the Lord; and, as the Lord is then behind him, it appears as though He hides or turns away: and it is a fact that all infernal Spirits turn the back to the Lord as a Sun, but the Angels the face; and in like manner man as to his spirit. HH 545:end.
By the correspondence between them, spiritual ideas are turned into natural ones when man speaks.

Some men turn themselves to the Lord, and thus to Heaven (in respect to the things of the Word); and some to themselves and the world; they who turn themselves to the Lord receive influx thence... but they who turn themselves to themselves and the world, cannot receive any influx from the Lord, and are therefore in no illustration. Explained.
The interiors of man also actually turn themselves according to the loves.
To turn one's self to the Lord, is to be turned by the Lord Himself... But to turn one's self to self is to be turned by Hell... HH 17:end.
All truth is turned into good as soon as it enters the will.

The reason (Angels and infernals) turn themselves in this way, is that all in the other life look towards the things which reign in their interiors, thus to their loves... Man, too, as to his spirit, turns himself in the same way...
The whole Heaven turns itself to the Lord as its common centre; and hence all the Angels turn themselves thither... The interiors of the Angels are actually turned forwards...

The east is in front of the Angels in every turning of their faces and bodies... The Angels, like men, turn and bend their faces and bodies in every direction... but the turnings of the Angels are not like those of men... for the reigning love is the origin with them. Explained.
Thus is a natural idea of man turned into a spiritual idea with the Angels.
If anyone in the congregation dissents, he must turn away his face.

As heavenly loves open the interiors to the Lord, therefore all the Angels turn their faces to Him; for in the Spiritual World it is the love which turns the interiors of everyone to itself, and wherever it turns the interiors, it also turns the face. Explained.
The delights of the love of self and the world are there turned into painful and direful things...
(In the third state after death) he turns his face constantly to his own love... however he may turn himself round.
(Even) the spirit in man, when it turns itself away from another, is no longer in his view.
That after death the delights of life of everyone are turned into corresponding things. Chapter.

At sight of them the good Spirits turn themselves away; and, in proportion as they turn themselves away, the evil Spirits who are being carried round, have their faces turned away from them to the quarter where is their infernal Society. Not to mention other methods of separation.
If the Lord were to turn Himself away, and the man were to be left to his evil alone, he would be no longer a man.
He then turns himself away from the Lord, and turns his face to the Hell with which he had been conjoined here.
The interiors... of those who love themselves above all things are turned to self and the world, thus are turned away from the Lord and Heaven.
Genii, in a moment, turn good affections into evil ones. Explained.
Good Spirits can see evil ones; but they turn themselves away from them; and Spirits who turn themselves away, become invisible.
For the sense of the letter can be turned in every direction... without its internal being injured... This guard is signified by the cherubs and flaming sword which turned this way and that ().
The third reason (why the Sun appears at a middle height) is that the Angels are thus enabled to turn their faces constantly to the Lord.
That the Angels constantly turn their faces to the Lord as a Sun. General article. DP 29:2.
All that is here said of the turning of the Angels to the Lord as a Sun, is to be understood of man also, as to his spirit. Illustrated.

That the Angels turn their faces constantly to the Lord as a Sun, is because they are in the Lord and the Lord in them, and the Lord interiorly leads their affections and thoughts, and turns them constantly to Himself... from which it is evident that the Angels do not turn themselves to the Lord, but that He turns them to Himself. Explained. DP 29:2.

The turning of the Angels to the Lord is such that in every turning of their bodies they look to the Lord as a Sun before them. An Angel can turn himself round and round, and thus see the various things around him, and still the Lord as a Sun appears constantly before his face... For many years I, too, have thus seen the Lord as a Sun, to whatever quarter of the world I have turned myself.
(Thus) the universal Heaven turns itself to the Lord, and, by this turning, Heaven is ruled... as one man.
That all the interiors, of both mind and body, of the Angels, are turned to the Lord as a Sun. General article. DLW 137, Explained.
This turning to the Lord is an actual turning: it is a kind of elevation. Explained.
Hence it is that these turn themselves back from the Lord; and (this) is to turn themselves to Hell.
This actual turning to the Lord, is from love and at the same time wisdom. Explained.
That every Spirit, whatever his quality, in like manner turns himself to his reigning love. General article. DLW 143, Explained.

As all in love to the Lord turn themselves to the Lord as a Sun... all in the love of dominating from the love of self turn themselves back from the Lord. The reason they thus turn themselves in an opposite way. Explained. DLW 144.
They can turn themselves round and round, yet all the things they see around them appear like their love.
How the goods and truths of Heaven are turned, in the Hells, into evils and falsities. (Shown by an experiment.) DP 288. DP 307, Explained. TCR 492. AE 518:2. AE 1147:4.
They are (then) turned into direfulnesses.
This delight of infernal love is turned into what is undelightful, painful, and direful. DP 324:8.
With him who is being regenerated, the order of life is turned...
The man then turns his face from the devil to the Lord; and, when he turns his face to the Lord, love and wisdom are given him: these enter man by the face, and not by the nape.
Good can be turned into evil, not by good, but by the recipient evil; for every form turns what Hows into it into its own quality.
They shall see His face... = that they will turn themselves to the Lord, and the Lord will turn Himself to them, because they are conjoined by love.
She then turned herself away sideways from her husband, and I could survey her more intently.
Man himself, by a turning from God to himself, implanted in himself the origin of evil.
I will call any evil Spirit, who turns away himself from God, and I will speak to him from behind, and you will see that (all) things are turned into their contraries.
All the Angels of Heaven turn the forehead to the Lord as a Sun, and all the angels of Hell turn the occiput to Him. (The consequence.)

Man himself turns himself away as does the Earth from the sun; and, when he turns himself away from the truths of wisdom, it is like the Earth turned away from the sun in the night-time; and, when he turns himself away from the goods of love, it is like the Earth turned away from the sun in the winter-time.
Murder, in the spiritual sense, means... to turn men away from God... by persuading to such things as cause a turning away, and also aversion.
Evil was introduced by man, because man turns into evil the good which is continually inflowing from God, by turning away himself from God, and turning himself to himself.
All in Hell turn away the face from the Lord...
As evils are removed, they turn away themselves from the Lord, and successively invert themselves.
The appearances of truth, while passing from man to Heaven, are turned into genuine truths... I have often observed this... turning in the World of Spirits.
An evil Spirit perpetually turns himself away from the Lord, and constantly looks towards his own love, and this in every turning of his body and face. Explained.
How good is turned into evil by Spirits. (Explained.)
Three general causes by which good is turned into evil...
And in like manner by which truth is turned into falsity.
Wherever I turned my body, (all the Spirits) appeared in the same relative situation in regard to it.
Good is turned into evil by the evil, and truth into falsity...
So that the Spirit is turned into such things.
The evil are thus turned into serpents...
I asked whether anyone had been turned into a dog...
All good inflowing into the World of Spirits is turned into evil...
A Siren who could turn others into monsters, and into apes. SE 4381.
Mutual love and the faith of Heaven... when they descend into the World of Spirits... are turned into a filthy adulterine sphere.
He said that he regards such things, but they are sometimes turned into mire.
The evils they try to inflict, are turned by the Lord into good. SE 5509.
On those who are turned into animals.
On turning to the Lord, and on turning from the Lord.
To be turned to Him is a sign of being led by Him, and of being continually in His presence...

That the evil can be thus vastated... is because they thus turn themselves to their loves: whithersoever they turn themselves, their loves are in front of them... They cannot be turned from any other source than the Lord... but they fall back.

a. They are examined... and then turn themselves to the west; and, when they are turned to the east, they spring back... For to be turned to the west is to be turned to the world; but to be turned to the east is to be turned to Heaven. Some also turn themselves to the east while they are thinking about it... but this is apparent; for the Angels then look at their interiors, which turn of their own accord.
When they turned the face to me, they believed; but as soon as they turn themselves to their own loves... they are at once in a like faith to that in which they had been in the world.
On those who can turn away the thoughts.
That which was with the Angels... was turned into evil and falsity by a wonderful turning, or gyre, as it flowed down towards Hell.

For these loves... turn all their thoughts and intentions to themselves and the world... The interiors of man are actually turned to his loves... When a man loves God above all things, and the neighbour as himself, then the Lord turns the interiors of his mind to Himself... and thus turns them away from his proprium... Hence it is that the spirit of man... after its release from the body, is actually turned to its own love... This may be illustrated by the fact that all the least things of the body turn themselves to the common centre of our world... but there is another centre of gravity in the Spiritual World. Explained.

The Lord... turns and draws all to Himself... but those in evil and falsities do not follow (the turning), but turn themselves back from the Lord; and to turn themselves back from the Lord is to turn from Heaven to Hell. Explained.

Man, as to his spirit, then turns himself away from the Lord, and consequently does not perceive good or see truth... It is from this appearance that the Lord is said to hide His face. Illustrated. AC 5585:6. AC 5798.
That it is man who... turns himself away from the Lord. Illustrated.

That the evil turn away their face from the Lord... means that they do it with the face of their spirit. Man can turn his face whithersoever he pleases, because he is in a free state to turn himself to either Heaven or Hell... but when he becomes a Spirit... he who has lived in evils, completely turns away the face from the Lord. This is meant by, They have turned the nape and not the face ().

When the good are being separated from the evil... the Lord causes (the former) to turn themselves to Him, and thus to turn themselves away from the evil; and, when they turn themselves, they become invisible to the evil; for it is a general thing there, that when anyone turns himself away from another, he becomes invisible to him.
When the Divine love descends... into Societies where the evil are, it is turned into a love contrary to the Divine love, and thus into various ardours of cupidities... and (therefore) into torments.

That when the Divine truth descends from Heaven into the (World of Spirits), where the evil are, it is turned into falsity. References. For the Divine truth is turned into such falsity as is the evil in those with whom it inflows.
The sun shall be turned into darkness... (). Explained.
They have Power over the waters, to turn them into blood () = that the truths with them are turned into falsities from evil.
Their backslidings have become strong () = adulterations of good.

For with them all the good of Heaven is turned into evil, and all the truth into falsity; for their interiors... are in a contrary turning to heavenly things; and whatever inflows into what is contrary, is turned into what is contrary; and, if that which inflows grows strong, it is turned into fury; and, if it prevails, into torment.
To turn and rend () = to treat with ignominy and contumely.
For these loves turn all things of the mind downwards and outwards...

The interiors of all things of the mind... can be turned downwards, and can be turned upwards: they are turned downwards when the man loves himself above all things; and they are turned upwards when he loves the Lord above all things. There is an actual turning. From himself, man turns them downwards; and, from Himself, the Lord turns them upwards. It is the reigning love which turns them. The thoughts do not turn the interiors of the mind except in so far as they derive from the will.
